tail_rule.value: For v at or above ceil(t+C), g_l(v)=v-a_t-omega_l*C. Thus q_n,l(v)=v-1 for n at or above that cutoff, bar_g has constant tail, and every remaining sum is an exact geometric zeroth or first moment.

vertex_table_semantics.value: These are exact values of the globally defined separately concave full absorbed margin with C=1. Predecessor epsilon values remain only lower bounds.

scope.value: General CellCost accepts a nonnegative rational C, but this certificate evaluates only C=1 for h4 and h5. Independent original labels and complete tails are preserved; ordinary source-law proof plus exact arithmetic, no unrestricted endpoint.
